name: (Melfesh Monster) Burrowing Grasp

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: The Melfesh Monster Burrows twice. At any point in this movement, it can shed a temporary fungal limb to grasp a creature within 10 feet. The creature must succeed at a DC 21 Reflex save save or be Immobilized for 1 round (on a critical failure, 2 rounds) or until it Escapes. This ability grants the Melfesh Monster a burrow speed of 15 feet and replaces its fly speed and Envelop.
